scope: framework CI dev-add timeout; initial collection watcher scan
facts: The unmodified pnpm verify:packed-framework passed locally.
The home Vite watcher used ignoreInitial=true by default and startup did not wait for its initial source scan.
Creating third/slides.md inside the initial watcher readdir left the catalog at [second,welcome]; editing welcome later made third appear.

Replacing only the generated dev-worker.js with transpiled 55a5bc8^ source reproduced the same omission for 35 seconds; a later edit recovered third. The collection watcher source is unchanged between 55a5bc8^ and HEAD.
The regression test fails against the original generated dev.mjs after 30 seconds and passes with ignoreInitial=false.

Holding the first sourceRoot watcher read until after server readiness and then creating third reproduced [second,welcome] for 32 seconds with the HEAD watcher; the fixed watcher discovered third without another filesystem edit.
inference: The CI failure is consistent with this startup race. CI load can change scan timing, but the saved CI log has no watcher/refresh trace to prove the exact interleaving or quantify runner slowness.
fix: Set ignoreInitial=false on the home watcher so files first found after the catalog snapshot trigger collection reconciliation. Retain 200ms polling, the 250ms debounce and the existing verification timeouts.
